subject: Security discovery — air‑gapped feasibility & SOC 2 evidence request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@cardinalhealthtech.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Security discovery — air-gapped feasibility & SOC 2 evidence request

Hi Emily — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the Private deployment evaluation: 

1) High-level asks from your side that we covered:
- Confirmed need: on-prem / VPC-first deployment with network isolation and an option for an air‑gapped build for select workloads.
- Compliance: Cardinal is targeting HIPAA scope for PHI and wants to confirm Redwood’s current SOC 2 status, pen test cadence, and data retention/audit log options.
- Procurement: Cardinal security team will run our vendor questionnaire and needs a reference diagram and evidence artifacts to start the review.

2) What Redwood will provide by EOD tomorrow:
- SOC 2 Type II summary + pen test high-level notes (attached stub).
- A concise, non‑production deployment diagram showing VPC boundaries, optional air‑gap isolation, and KMS/HSM placement (attached PNG).
- A short writeup on encryption at rest/in transit, key management options, and audit log locations.
- Link to the vendor security questionnaire intake form for your team to kick off.

3) Proposed next steps / asks for your team:
- Can your security team share an initial copy of the vendor questionnaire or a link to the portal?
- Do you have preferred timelines for the evidence review (we can prioritize SOC 2 docs vs full artifact set)?
- Which environments would you want air‑gapped (inference only, or training + inference)?

Attachments: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (stub), high-level-deployment-diagram.png (stub)

I’ll follow up with the attachments + intake link in a minute. If you want to loop in your cloud/network lead, please include them on replies.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
P: (415) 555-0198
From: Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@cardinalhealthtech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
Cc: security@cardinalhealthtech.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 15:30:14 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery — air-gapped feasibility & SOC 2 evidence request

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We will run the vendor security questionnaire through our portal (link below) but need the SOC 2 artifacts first so the tool can auto‑map evidence. If you can attach the SOC 2 summary and the pen test cadence that will save us time.
- For air‑gap scope: initially inference-only (customers want model answers and routing isolated). We may later expand to model fine-tuning but that’s a separate budget/timeline ask.
- Timeline: security would like to complete the initial pass within two weeks (by 2027-04-05).

Portal link: https://vendor-portal.cardinalhealthtech.com/sq/8371

I’m copying our security mailbox; they’ll be the ones to accept the attachments and start the questionnaire.

Emily Sanchez
Director, Cloud Integrations
Cardinal HealthTech
emily.sanchez@cardinalhealthtech.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@cardinalhealthtech.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwoodai.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:05:42 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery — air-gapped feasibility & SOC 2 evidence request

Emily / Ben — capturing a couple of technical notes for the questionnaire intake so your security reviewers have concise answers: 

- SOC 2: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II report covering Redundancy & Security controls (redacted report available). We’ll attach the SOC 2 executive summary + the control matrix mapping. Our report window is Jan–Dec 2026.
- Pen tests: annual third‑party penetration test (most recent: 2026‑10). We provide an executive summary and remediation timeline; full findings are redacted for customer consumption.
- Air‑gapped option: we support an on‑prem air‑gapped bundle that includes an offline installer, separate KMS integration via local HSM, and an operator-run orchestration kit. This configuration disables outbound telemetry by default and routes logs to customer‑controlled sinks.
- Network isolation: recommended pattern is a private VPC with dedicated subnet for inference nodes, NAT disabled for inference subnets, and a management bastion in a separate admin subnet (diagram attached).
- Data handling: we can configure token-level retention off by default and export audit logs in an S3-compatible bucket under your control.

Deliverables attached: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, high-level-deployment-diagram.png. I can also produce a sanitized control-mapping spreadsheet if the portal needs CSV ingestion — Ben, want me to prep that for the vendor portal?

Lauren Bishop
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com
From: CardinalHealthTech Security <security@cardinalhealthtech.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Emily Sanchez <emily.sanchez@cardinalhealthtech.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security discovery — air-gapped feasibility & SOC 2 evidence request

Thanks Lauren — this is exactly what we need to start the intake. A couple of quick follow-ups from the security team: 

1) Please upload the SOC 2 executive summary + control matrix to the portal (https://vendor-portal.cardinalhealthtech.com/sq/8371) — we prefer portal uploads for traceability.
2) Can you confirm whether the air‑gapped installer supports offline patching (patch bundle model) and whether HSM integrations are FIPS 140‑2 compliant?
3) For the audit logs: a sample log schema (fields/timestamp format) would help our SIEM mapping. If you can drop a small sample (sanitized) log file we can validate ingestion.

If you can get the portal upload and answers by EOD tomorrow we’ll aim to complete the questionnaire initial pass by 2027‑04‑05 as requested.

—Cardinal HealthTech Security Team
security@cardinalhealthtech.com
(Attachments referenced above are stubs in this export: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), high-level-deployment-diagram.png (png).
